title: LL-979 • The Moonwood Treeport
description: Ewok engineers have rebuilt a 1979 blue-and-grey Galaxy Explorer as a timber-podded forest shuttle. Yellow bubble glazing, original space insignia and rocket fins meet bark, thatch and a suspended log bridge. A forest control hut fuels the shuttle while an Ewok radio operator calls the next moon.
